🔥🇲 "Don't lie, don't steal, and never betray the people of Mexico." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Teapa, Tabasco In Tabasco — birthplace of the Fourth Transformation — Sheinbaum delivered universal pensions, Beca Rita Cetina scholarships for secondary students, and launched house-to-house healthcare. May 31: national accountability report broadcast live across all 32 states.

🇲✊ "We govern for the people and by the people of Mexico. That will not change — because we have principles and causes." "I didn't become president just to arrive and say 'that's enough.' We came to keep fighting for the people — because from the presidency, you lead the people's struggle." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Teapa, Tabasco

🇲🌎 "Mexico is no one's colony. We are no one's protectorate. Mexico — with great honor and pride — is a free, independent, and sovereign country." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Teapa, Tabasco Sheinbaum in Tabasco delivering welfare programs ahead of her May 31 national accountability report — broadcast live across all 32 state capitals to mark two years since winning the presidency.

🇲🇽🏗️ President meets the workers building southern Mexico's infrastructure. — Macuspana-Escárcega highway site, Tabasco The highway includes the Pozo Azul and Agua Blanca bridges, interchanges, and bus stops. When complete, it will cut travel times across three states and open Tabasco's production to the Yucatán Peninsula.

🇲🇽🚧 Sheinbaum inspects Macuspana-Escárcega highway expansion — 250 km, 4 lanes, connecting Tabasco, Campeche, and Chiapas. — Macuspana, Tabasco $21 billion peso investment. 34,000 jobs. 760,000+ direct beneficiaries. First stage at 80% completion. Timeline cut from 6 years to 3.
